description: This file contains utility functions, type definitions, and constants related to sandbox environment configuration, command execution, directory resolution, string manipulation, and logging within a larger project. It appears to be a shared utility module for managing sandboxed execution environments in a system that interacts with Docker and filesystem paths.

methods.name: buildSandboxEnv
methods.description: Constructs environment variables for sandbox container, merging default, sandbox, and parameter-specific variables.

methods.name: coerceEnv
methods.description: Converts environment variables from process.env or Record<string, string> to a plain Record<string, string> with only string values.

methods.name: buildDockerExecArgs
methods.description: Generates command-line arguments for executing a command inside a Docker container with specified environment and working directory.

methods.name: resolveSandboxWorkdir
methods.description: Resolves the working directory inside the sandbox, verifying its existence and directory status, with fallback and warnings.

methods.name: resolveWorkdir
methods.description: Validates and resolves a given working directory path, with fallback to current directory or home directory.

methods.name: clampWithDefault
methods.description: Clamps a number within min and max bounds, using a default if input is undefined or NaN.

methods.name: readEnvInt
methods.description: Reads an integer value from environment variables by key.

methods.name: chunkString
methods.description: Splits a string into chunks of specified size.

methods.name: truncateMiddle
methods.description: Truncates a string in the middle with ellipsis if it exceeds a maximum length.

methods.name: sliceLogLines
methods.description: Extracts a slice of log lines from a text, with total line and character counts.

methods.name: deriveSessionName
methods.description: Generates a session name based on a command string, truncating and cleaning target parts.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Pads a string with spaces to a specified width.
